powers.label: Warp
powers.note: ME3's Warp (SFXPowerCustomAction_Warp: CastSound, ImpactSound), plus the cast clip's cloth foley (HMM_BC_ThrowBiotic's SFXAnimNotify_RaceWwiseEvent).

powers.label: Lift
powers.note: ME3 has no Lift; its Pull (SFXPowerCustomAction_Pull: CastSound, ImpactSound) floats the target the same way, so Lift sounds and looks like it (its lift crust is named here: only code references it).
